primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.readingScope: Selected continuous scenes across all nine chapters and targeted follow-ups, including complete retained decisive confrontations. Not continuous full-novel reading, not a Russian-edition collation.
primaryEvidenceActuallyChecked.liveFetchLimitation: This independent run’s web-tool requests to the author’s full-edition and intro URLs timed out. Review used the already privately retained author-hosted complete HTML/extraction supplied for this task; primary content was available and read, so this is not a source gap.

contentJudgment: The revision is an engaging, materially supported condensation of a family’s changing forms and fortunes, rather than a prediction report or lesson plan. Manfred, Amber and Sirhan keep distinct arcs; the two shorter routes explicitly stop at first-contact threshold. Primary checks support Pamela’s coercion and last act, the decoy’s moral uncertainty, family-copy identities, Aineko’s attributed claims and the ending’s unresolved status. One local casualty substitution in Router requires repair. No source-gap or wholesale-rebuild finding is warranted.

wording.ru: «Пьер сражается с вторгшимися существами и теряет параллельные версии себя». При этом гибель Глашвича не сообщается.
wording.en: “Pierre fights the intruders and loses parallel instances of himself.” Glashwiecz’s death is omitted.

requiredFindings.finding: The retained fight does not establish the loss of Pierre’s parallel selves. He fears that his current instance could die, then he and Boris fork to kill the intruders. The narrative later returns to one Pierre and a trauma filter suppressing memories of parallel mass killing. Regrouping after forking is not evidence of the death of his copies. The explicit personal casualty is Glashwiecz, whom the Wunch kills and consumes before the fight. The condensation substitutes an unsupported loss for that crucial consequence of his direct deal.

minimalCorrection.ru: Заменить фразу о потере копий короткой причинной цепочкой: «Вунч убивает Глашвича. Пьер и Борис создают параллельные версии себя и расправляются с нападавшими; затем фильтр памяти Пьера подавляет ужас пережитого насилия». Графические подробности не нужны; остальную сцену сохранить.
minimalCorrection.en: Replace the loss-of-copies claim with the actual sequence: the Wunch kills Glashwiecz; Pierre and Boris fork themselves to fight the intruders; afterward Pierre’s trauma filter suppresses memories of the violence. No graphic detail or extra screen is required.
